name: etherhiding-onchain-loader
note: EtherHiding: a CommonJS module with an obfuscation-free loader appended after module.exports (self-executes on require). On a throttled loop it reads the latest tx from an attacker Tron wallet (Aptos node as fallback), follows a pointer to a BSC tx, pulls the calldata via eth_getTransactionByHash, XOR-decrypts it, and runs it two ways: eval() and a detached hidden `node -e` child process. The chain is the command channel, so the committed code never changes and there is no server to seize. Blocks on onchain-c2-loader (chain-read co-located with an executor) and on the hidden self-node exec — even in this de-obfuscated form, before the obfuscation heuristic would fire on the real packed sample.
